SELECT f.id, f.form_no AS formNo, f.applicant_id AS applicantId, e.name AS applicantName, f.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, f.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, f.total_amount AS totalAmount, f.item_count AS itemCount, f.reason, f.status, f.total_node AS totalNode, f.submit_time AS submitTime, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM expense_form f LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON e.id = f.applicant_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = f.dept_id LEFT JOIN expense_category c ON c.id = f.category_id
ORDER BY f.id DESC
